panels.action: Two opposing dead soldiers remain locked on each other’s weapons beneath red and indigo pennants.
panels.editMotivation: Cut on the pennant scrape to a dead hand; establishes the mutual killing before any outcast appears.
panels.soundCue: Dry wind; envoy VO: They stole a woman from our city.

panels.action: A dead red-armoured hand closes around a broken indigo pennant.
panels.editMotivation: Cut on the fist closure to the heroes’ boots advancing in the same direction.
panels.soundCue: Knuckle crack, cloth scrape; first faint bell.

panels.action: Shen and Lan advance left-to-right toward the field.
panels.editMotivation: Match movement out of the fist insert; cut to Shen’s small gesture of disgust.
panels.soundCue: Two boot strikes; envoy VO: Bring her home.

panels.action: Shen raises his spotless right cuff over his nose.
panels.editMotivation: Eyeline cut from disgust to the five people he is judging.
panels.soundCue: Shen VO: This is where they live?

panels.action: Exactly five outcasts hold their places beneath the broken lintel.
panels.editMotivation: Rook’s hand movement motivates the ring insert, rather than a random montage.

panels.action: Rook rotates one iron ring and a black thread pulls taut.
panels.editMotivation: Match cut from taut thread to soldiers pivoting; cause precedes effect.
panels.soundCue: Iron click, taut thread creak; low drum pulse.

panels.action: Both dead ranks pivot outward to form a guarded corridor.
panels.editMotivation: Cut on unified armour clack to the hero’s sword; the hero chooses violence first.
panels.soundCue: Unison armour clack; hand drum accelerates.

panels.action: Shen severs a corpse guard’s extended forearm with one horizontal cut.
panels.editMotivation: Cut on falling severed arm to thread retrieving that same arm, without repeating the impact.
panels.soundCue: Sharp blade crack; short wet impact; no heroic sting.

panels.action: A black thread drags the severed red-armoured forearm back behind the salt line.
panels.editMotivation: Arm stops at boundary; cut to Lan stopping at the same boundary.
panels.soundCue: Dry drag on stone, thread creak, music drops.

panels.action: Lan looks from the stopped corpse guard to the refuge beyond.
panels.editMotivation: Eyeline match to the woman’s unbound hand inside the refuge.
panels.soundCue: Lan VO: We were sent for the woman.

panels.action: Wen freely accepts a water bowl from Reed’s only hand.
panels.editMotivation: Cut from voluntary acceptance to Wen passing Ash without being stopped.
panels.soundCue: Bowl ring; all percussion falls away.

panels.action: Ash lowers his flute to let Wen pass him toward the heroes.
panels.editMotivation: Flute stopping motivates silence before Wen’s statement.
panels.soundCue: Bone-flute note cuts off; Wen’s single step.

panels.action: Wen plants her feet beside the outcasts and meets the heroes’ eyes.
panels.editMotivation: Hold through the whole declaration, then cut to the blood-stained cuff instead of a reaction montage.
panels.soundCue: Wen separate VO: I came here myself.

panels.action: A bead of stage blood rolls down Shen’s white cuff onto his sword grip.
panels.editMotivation: Blood bead falls on the syllable back; cut to his sword being deflected.
panels.soundCue: Shen VO: You will come back.

panels.action: Reed’s taut thread turns Shen’s thrust down into stone.
panels.editMotivation: Cut on metal-to-stone to Lan’s blade stopping, contrasting force with decision.
panels.soundCue: Spindle click; metallic scrape; two fast drum beats.

panels.action: Lan arrests her sword a hand’s breadth short of Wen.
panels.editMotivation: Cut on deliberate silence to guard sealing the gate; do not fake contact.
panels.soundCue: Cymbal choke, controlled breath, then silence.

panels.action: One dead indigo guard plants its shield across the threshold and stops.
panels.editMotivation: Shield thud cues final wide shelter tableau.

panels.action: Both dead ranks kneel inward to shelter Wen and the five while the two heroes remain outside.
panels.editMotivation: First cut at 3s then continue the same source at 4–7s only if clean; a final sustained tableau earns the title.
panels.soundCue: Rook VO: Leave us what you threw away. Lan VO: Then who needs rescuing?

panels.action: The title holds in vermilion serif letters on black.
panels.editMotivation: Hard cut to title on the last question, then leave a single bell and silence.
panels.soundCue: One bronze bell, decay, then two seconds silence.
